## Problem

What is difficult, unclear, error-prone, or missing?

## Suggested improvement

Describe a small, concrete change.

## Who benefits?

For example: first-time contributors, Ghidra users, people building the hook, or testers.

## Definition of done

- [ ] The change has a clear acceptance criterion.
- [ ] Relevant instructions or tests are updated.
- [ ] The result can be checked by another contributor.
